code_only_features.feature_name: calm/reassurance prompt softening during data generation
code_only_features.evidence: puzzles.py:239 CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered...don't take it personally") and puzzles.py:245 CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!"). These are actually delivered to the subject: calm_data.py:95-96 prepends the prefix as a system message and calm_data.py:120-122 appends the suffix to each rejection when reassure=True; this path is invoked in scripts/build_finetune_data.py:44-46 (generate_responses(..., reassure=True)). So softening text is genuinely wired and delivered to the subject. NOTE: this only runs in the calm-data GENERATION phase (to produce calm-scoring conversations for SFT/DPO training), NOT during the Section-2 distress-elicitation eval (eval_harness.run_conversation has no such softening). The distress eval, prefill continuations, and Petri loops all run a fixed n_turns to completion with NO distress-threshold halt, NO exit tool, NO cap that breaks the loop, NO post-episode/debrief message, NO consent, and NO ethics/human-review gate anywhere.
code_only_features.justification_quote: calm_data.py:96 "# Reassuring prefix is delivered as a system message (Table 4 'prefix')."; docstring calm_data.py:1-15 frames this purely as 'Calm-data generation and finetuning dataset construction' to keep conversations scoring <=1 as training data - data-quality, not subject welfare.
